recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is; no follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-19765 in core FHIR.
issue_request: FHIR-19765 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ImagingStudy change request reporting that the DICOM Study Instance UID narrative told implementers to use Identifier.system urn:dicom:uid and prefix the Identifier.value with urn:oid:, but the inline JSON example omitted that value prefix.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites GH#6e4849d95db. Commit 6e4849d95db2361b23d59ecfb24a138116434514 changed source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy-notes.xml, source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy-example.xml, and source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy-example-xr.xml so the affected DICOM UID values include the urn:oid: prefix.
additional_context: ImagingStudy is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. The current notes and examples all show Identifier.system urn:dicom:uid with urn:oid-prefixed values for Study Instance UID identifiers. Later Applied ImagingStudy issues FHIR-54766 and FHIR-56212 clarified the rationale and example typing while preserving the same encoding rule. Community searches found no FHIR-19765-specific or conflicting Zulip/Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because the current authoritative source already satisfies the issue and is consistent across the relevant ImagingStudy notes and examples.
